definition: Too wrong or unreasonable to be forgiven or accepted.
author: Joseph Conrad
quote: I admit my behaviour was inexcusable, but then my temperature was seldom normal in these days.
example_sentence: Putting pineapple in the Christmas pudding was, frankly, inexcusable.
